knownIssues.title: Air conditioning problems
knownIssues.description: The air conditioning system on this generation can lose refrigerant charge over time and suffer compressor or condenser faults, leading to weak, intermittent or no cooling.

fixes.summary: Recharge refrigerant and check for leaks
fixes.steps: Vacuum test the A/C circuit, locate and seal any leak, then recharge to the specified refrigerant weight.

fixes.summary: Replace a seized or noisy A/C compressor
fixes.steps: Remove the drive belt, disconnect the refrigerant lines, replace the compressor and receiver-drier, then evacuate and recharge the system.

fixes.summary: Clean or replace a blocked condenser
fixes.steps: Inspect the condenser for debris or damage, clean it or replace it if bent fins or a leak are found, then recharge the system.

knownIssues.title: Coil pack / ignition coil failure
knownIssues.description: Ignition coils on this engine family can fail intermittently, causing misfires and a rough idle, especially in damp weather.

fixes.steps: Identify the misfiring cylinder via OBD-II fault codes, then replace the affected coil pack(s).
